tasks.short: Maintain and guard bridge stations while checking boat traffic

steps.what: Maintain the actual station's readiness and physical condition
Guard the station and observe the waterway for actual boat traffic

tasks.design: Keep actual station maintenance, guarding and boat observation human. Existing waterway observation displays in {OPS_SYSTEM} support the watch, but their runtime and recorded feeds are not new labour savings, and no unattended opening decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is physical readiness and continuing observation rather than repeated data preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing observation displays already support the station watch.
tasks.still_hard: Changing visibility, traffic behaviour and the difference between a display and the actual scene.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unusual activity and recognise when the available view is insufficient.

evidence.claim: Rijkswaterstaat remote control rooms use cameras, VHF, AIS and radar; that capability supports observation and does not establish autonomous safe bridge opening.

assumptions: Shares are provisional physical station work and watch time, not measured savings. The operations slot is the existing bridge/waterway observation environment; its automatic feeds earn no labour credit.
Actual station and waterway conditions produce the inputs. s1 counts physical readiness work; s2 counts the continuing watch, including reading existing displays.

Record, lookup and send boundaries were inspected before zero. This statement does not assign a new station activity report or traffic tally; defect reporting is explicitly modelled in the separate inspection task. Do not invent an extra record here or count the same defect report twice.

A native station view and checklist are considered; they cannot perform physical upkeep or replace the actual watch. Any observed station-owned tally, status entry or handover send must be added and assessed before confirming zero.
No new implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Any real watch tally or handover record beyond the separate defect task
research_questions: Observe a watch and isolate any actual tally, status write or send before confirming the physical-only estimate.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 45 physical station-maintenance and 55 guard/observation points. Poor visibility retains human verification rather than making existing camera runtime a labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect bridge and canal equipment and report defects

steps.what: Inspect actual canal and bridge equipment and areas for damage or defects
Prepare the necessary defect report for the supervisor

loop.purpose: Restate captured defect observations without diagnosing their cause
loop.input: actual inspection findings and equipment references
loop.check: Tender checks location, observed damage, uncertainty, urgency and omissions against actual findings
loop.stop: Missing location or two failed drafts returns writing to the tender
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fault form first; variable descriptions of damage need limited supported restatement

steps.what: Check the complete final defect report and supervisor destination
Send the exact checked defect report to the supervisor

tasks.design: Use the existing defect form in the bridge-maintenance module of {OPS_SYSTEM}, with bounded restatement only for the tender's actual damage observations. Keep all physical inspection and complete report checking, then send the exact checked report to the supervisor as a separate gated action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Describing actual defects clearly for the supervisor takes writing time after inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fault forms and source-bound description drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying damage, judging uncertain observations and deciding when urgent human contact is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Relate the physical defect to the actual bridge or canal context.
tasks.altitude: Less report restatement; inspection and escalation responsibilities stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a fault form and source-bound restatement can assist defect reporting without identifying defects or diagnosing equipment failure.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe the statement's actual written-report branch, where a defect is found and a supervisor report is necessary. A no-defect inspection or immediate oral report has a different reweighted graph, with no document-writing benefit assumed.

s1 includes actual finding capture: asset, location, time, observed condition and any available photograph. The existing asset register supplies equipment references, verified in s2. Missing observations remain manual, never inferred from the asset name.

Test the native fault form first. Four removed points concern supported descriptive restatement only. Physical inspection, factual capture, full meaning checking, ordinary author save and the real supervisor send remain.

s3 checks the exact final report and destination after it exists; edits void its send approval. The gate covers an actual supervisor notification, not an internal author save. Urgent site communication is not delayed for drafting.
unknowns: Actual reporting channel and report length
Whether native fault descriptions already remove repeated wording
research_questions: Does restatement reduce actual writing after the tender's complete meaning check?

incremental.description: Maintain fault-form mappings and restatement checks

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final defect report, attachments and supervisor destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 20%=4 descriptive-restatement points less 0.6 upkeep gives 3.4. An unusual bridge mechanism requires bespoke wording and uncertainty explanation, leaving only 1 point of supported factual restatement removable and 0.4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain station watch and physical inspection while reducing supported writing in actual defect reports.
skills_to_grow: Check defect descriptions against observed conditions
role.ambitious_version: Use verified report-writing savings for closer physical observation, without extending bridge-control authority.
